statement: Fix d ≥ 1 and A∗ > 1. There is a constant C, depending only on these two quantities, with the following properties. Let n ≥ 2, b > 0, and ln(2n + 1) ≤ bn. Suppose that At, −n ≤ t < n, are upper triangular with positive diagonal and ∥At∥, ∥A−1 t ∥ ≤ A∗, u−1 X t=−n ln(At)jj − (u + n)λj ≤ bn for −n ≤ u ≤ n and 1 ≤ j ≤ d, where λj = (2n)−1 Pn−1 t=−n ln(At)jj. First, order the rates as λ(1) ≥ · · · ≥ λ(d). For every 0 ≤ q ≤ d and every −n ≤ s ≤ t ≤ n, ln ∥ ^q A(t, s)∥ − (t − s) q X j=1 λ(j) ≤ Cbn. (3.1) The analogous estimate for A(s, t) uses the q largest members of {−λ1, . . . , −λd}. 8 Next, suppose that real γ and g > 0 separate all the rates: each λj is at most γ − g or at least γ + g. Let F be the set of indices in the second group, let p = |F|, and put Λ = X j∈F λj, Ω = − X j / ∈F λj. There are decompositions Rd = Es t ⊕Ef t , −n ≤ t ≤ n, invariant under each At, with dim Ef t = p, whose two projections have norm at most eCbn. For s ≤ t and l = t − s they satisfy ∥A(t, s)|Es s∥ ≤ e(γ−g)l+Cbn , ∥A(s, t)|Ef t ∥ ≤ e−(γ+g)l+Cbn , (3.2) ∥ ^p A(t, s)∥ ≤ eΛl+Cbn , eΛl−Cbn ≤ Jp(A(t, s)|Ef s ) ≤ eΛl+Cbn , (3.3) ∥ ^d−p A(s, t)∥ ≤ eΩl+Cbn , eΩl−Cbn ≤ Jd−p(A(s, t)|Es t ) ≤ eΩl+Cbn . (3.4) If 0 < p < d and at least one of v1, . . . , vp belongs to Es s, then ∥A(t, s)v1 ∧ · · · ∧ A(t, s)vp∥ ≤ e(Λ−2g)l+Cbn p Y j=1 ∥vj∥. (3.5) The backward analogue has exterior degree d − p, exponent (Ω − 2g)l + Cbn, and at least one factor in Ef t . When a group is empty its space is {0}, all statements on that space are vacuous, and the exterior-degree-zero conventions apply.
